rv.q: What we get is a jokey travesty that leads me to agree with Gwendolen that: 'On an occasion of this kind it becomes more than a moral duty to speak one's mind. It becomes a pleasure.'
The whole production is so odd that it stops it being funny and THE IMPORTANCE OF BEING EARNEST is usually a very funny play indeed.

cn.t: Critics pan this reimagined production, finding the framing device unnecessary and the concept misguided. Both reviews suggest the staging trivializes Wilde's comedy rather than enhancing it.
